text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - elevated 5xx rate detected in sa-east-1 edge pool. 5xx spike from 0.3% -> 7.8% over the last 3m. Automatically opened incident ticket INC-2134.

maya (oncall): I'm on it. pulling metrics and traces now.

maya (oncall): dashboards show gateway 502/504 across the regional edge proxies, spike started ~2134567600. traffic hasn't shifted yet.

rui (sre): pinging in. any recent deploys to sa-east-1?

maya (oncall): not from our deploy bot logs, last deploy was 2134560000. No config changes in the routing table in last 24h.

sam (runtime): seeing increased latency and downstream backend timeouts from mlworker pool in sa-east-1. KV cache miss rate also jumped. posting sample proxy logs: 
```
[2134567899] proxy: upstream_error status=502 conn_id=1243 path=/v1/generate rt=156ms backend=mlworker-sa-3 error="read timeout"
[2134567902] proxy: upstream_error status=504 conn_id=1247 path=/v1/embeddings rt=1020ms backend=mlworker-sa-1 error="context deadline exceeded"
```

terry (eng-infra): routing plane telemetry shows higher SYN retries to the regional NAT gateway and a flapping NAT target. possible egress network saturation.

maya (oncall): good catch. sam, can you confirm whether the mlworker pool is healthy? `kubectl get pods -n ml sa-* -o wide`

sam (runtime): pod list looks ok but CPU is normal, memory stable. logs indicate long GC pauses on a subset of workers (sa-1, sa-3). suspect an operational pressure on mlworker process causing connection stalls.

rui (sre): we should start a traffic steering to minimize customer impact. propose failover of new sessions from sa-east-1 to us-east-2 for 10m window while we heal. Sam/terry can we do a controlled steer?

terry (eng-infra): yes, can push a weighted route change. will prepare a canary: 20% -> 100% over 3m. queue depth and latency will be monitored.

anya (product): heads-up: a couple of paying customers (acct-042, acct-317) are pinned to sa-east-1 for compliance. check impact before moving them.

jordan (support): listing affected customers from error logs: acct-042 (high), acct-999 (medium), acct-701 (low). I'll open priority CS tickets and draft comms.

maya (oncall): agree, do not failover pinned customers. terry, can route policy exclude pinned tenant prefixes?

terry (eng-infra): yes, can set exclusion match on tenant tag. preparing route mutation now.

deploy-bot: Triggered route change job route-steer-213456 - submitted by terry.

terry (eng-infra): starting weighted change: sa-east-1 -> us-east-2 : 0% -> 20% (non-pinned).

maya (oncall): monitoring metrics. please post the query you are watching.

rui (sre): watching `sum(rate(proxy_upstream_5xx[1m])) by (region)` and `histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(proxy_request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m]))`.

maya (oncall): 1m after steer: 5xx dropped from 7.8% -> 4.2%. latency p95 improved slightly.

sam (runtime): collecting heap dumps from sa-1 and sa-3 for postmortem. also increasing worker connection pool timeouts temporarily (`worker.timeout=90s -> 120s`) to avoid premature retries.

rui (sre): step 2: ramp to 60% non-pinned over next 3m if metrics continue to improve. plan to keep pinned tenants on sa-east-1.

terry (eng-infra): ramping to 60% now. keep monitoring.

maya (oncall): observed side-effect: us-east-2 error rate bump from 0.2% -> 1.1% after ramp. not alarming but watching.

jordan (support): customers acct-042 flagged as pinned. outreach message queued, awaiting product approval.

anya (product): approve. send ack + note that we're mitigating and not moving them due to compliance. Lauren on enterprise success will handle account-042 call.

sam (runtime): heap dumps show recurring stalled goroutines in the mlworker ingest path for long-running requests. pushing a near-term patch to restart affected pods gracefully.

deploy-bot: rolling restart job `mlworker/sa-east-restart-213456` started by sam. batch size 2 pods at a time.

maya (oncall): good, coordinate restart with steering to avoid double-impact.

rui (sre): recommend increasing drain timeout to 180s for the restart job to allow KV cache flush.

sam (runtime): applied drain timeout change. restart in progress.

~6m later~

maya (oncall): post-restart: sa-east-1 5xx is down to 0.9%, overall is now 0.6%. us-east-2 back to baseline.

terry (eng-infra): NAT retries cleared, connection errors falling. seems like egress stalls were downstream of hung worker connections.

maya (oncall): I'm paging close but keeping monitoring for 30m. any customer-facing comms to send now?

jordan (support): sending targeted message to acct-999 and acct-701: brief note explaining we saw elevated errors, steady-state restored, offering post-incident call. acct-042 already handled by Lauren.

anya (product): will prepare a short status update for customers and a more detailed postmortem draft.

rui (sre): next steps for postmortem: root cause hypothesis = intermittent ML worker ingest stalls causing upstream timeouts combined with NAT egress retry amplification. action items: 1) add healthcheck for blocked goroutine patterns 2) increase drain/timeout defaults 3) revisit NAT capacity alarms 4) add runbook step to exclude pinned-tenants from automated steer.

maya (oncall): logging timeline and saving traces to the incident ticket. leaving notes for followup.

maya (oncall): closing note: service recovered, customer impact low-medium for small set, pinned tenants preserved, postmortem owners assigned (rui/sam/terry/anya).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2134 marked resolved by maya at 2134567965. :white_check_mark:

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. we'll reconvene in the postmortem channel in ~48h with a draft. :thumbsup:
